findings.title: Confidentiality Obligations Survival
findings.rationale: The evidence explicitly states the duration for which confidentiality obligations survive after the agreement ends.
evidence_excerpts: This confidentiality obligation shall survive termination of this Agreement for a minimum of five years.

findings.title: Scope of Work and Deliverables Defined
findings.rationale: The evidence clearly outlines the scope of work and deliverables under the agreement, detailing various products, services, and components involved in the BFSI deployments.
evidence_excerpts: The scope of this Agreement is intentionally broad, covering every category of hardware, firmware, software-adjacent service, engineering activity, logistical operation, and maintenance initiative likely to arise throughout the lifecycle of BFSI deployments.

findings.title: Service Level and Performance Commitments
findings.rationale: The Vendor commits to maintaining clear pricing structures and ensuring that all service-related charges are transparent and predictable, which directly relates to service level commitments.
evidence_excerpts: The Vendor shall maintain a comprehensive pricing structure governing the cost of installation, device commissioning, software-hardware integration, firmware onboarding, branch-level workflow configuration, and technical validation.

findings.title: Client-Side Obligations for Vendor Performance
findings.rationale: The evidence specifies that the Vendor's performance is contingent upon the Client's requirements for manpower and operational dependencies, particularly for complex operations and installation services.
evidence_excerpts: If the Client requires manpower for complex operations such as security sandbox testing, PSU audit compliance support, mass firmware rollout campaigns, or large-scale device refresh cycles, such activities shall also be covered under the pricing model established in this Agreement.

findings.title: Performance Reporting in AMC
findings.rationale: The evidence specifies that the Vendor agrees to provide performance analytics reporting as part of the Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC), which is a key aspect of service performance measurement and reporting.
evidence_excerpts: AMC charges reflect industry-aligned maintenance obligations such as scheduled preventive visits, firmware patch cycles, device uptime monitoring, remote diagnostics, onsite support availability, real-time support desk access, and performance analytics reporting.

findings.title: Payment Terms and Invoicing Requirements
findings.rationale: The evidence outlines the pricing structure, invoicing requirements, and conditions under which charges can be made, ensuring clarity and predictability in financial transactions between the Vendor and Client.
evidence_excerpts: All invoices raised by the Vendor shall strictly correspond to the pricing categories and values stated in this Agreement.

findings.title: Pricing Structure Overview
findings.rationale: The evidence provides a comprehensive overview of the pricing structure, including device pricing frameworks, service rates, and cost components, ensuring clarity and predictability for the Client.
evidence_excerpts: The Vendor shall provide the Client with a meticulously detailed device pricing framework that lists the per-unit cost of every hardware category supplied under this collaboration.

findings.title: Price Escalation Clauses Present
findings.rationale: The contract includes specific clauses regarding price protection and escalation constraints, detailing how and when price adjustments can occur, as well as the conditions under which they are permissible.
evidence_excerpts: Accordingly, all hardware prices, deployment prices, and service prices defined within this Agreement shall remain protected for a minimum of twelve months from the date of execution.

findings.title: Renewal Pricing and Terms
findings.rationale: The contract specifies that any pricing amendments must be documented through a written addendum, and the Vendor will continue to honor all accepted purchase orders based on the current rate card until a new version is formally transitioned. This indicates that renewal pricing is tied to the existing rate card unless formally amended.
evidence_excerpts: The Vendor shall continue to honour all accepted purchase orders based on the current rate card until the Parties formally transition to a new version.

findings.title: Cap on Financial Exposure and Charges
findings.rationale: The contract explicitly prohibits the introduction of new financial charges outside the agreed terms, ensuring that the Client is protected from unexpected financial exposure.
evidence_excerpts: The Client shall not be obligated to pay for resource wait times, idle engineer hours, or vendor-driven deployment delays. This protects the Client from unexpected financial exposure and ensures absolute commercial predictability throughout the contract term.

consensus_actions: Review: [operational] Scope of Work and Deliverables Defined
Review: [financial] Cap on Financial Exposure and Charges
